drafts.organisation: Indian Business and Professional Council Dubai
drafts.subject: Nexora website editor for IBPC Dubai
drafts.text:
Hello IBPC Dubai team,

Your site brings together the council's membership categories and application information.

We've built Nexora, including a website CMS for staff-managed branded pages, navigation and content publishing. The website can be scoped on its own, with portal or CRM modules considered separately if useful.

I've attached a 90-second narrated introduction to the wider platform. It shows Nexora's membership workflow, rather than a dedicated website demonstration.

Would a brief look at the website editor be useful for your council?

Best,
Ramish Qureshi
Founder, Nexora
ramishqureshi99@gmail.com

Advertisement: Nexora website/CMS software.
